# MAILTYPE

MAILTYPE is a public REST + MCP API for objective email-domain infrastructure intelligence.

Docs: https://mailtype-api.onrender.com/docs
OpenAPI: https://mailtype-api.onrender.com/openapi.json
Playground: https://mailtype-api.onrender.com/play?q=gmail.com
MCP: https://mailtype-api.onrender.com/mcp
Sources: https://mailtype-api.onrender.com/sources
Health: https://mailtype-api.onrender.com/health
Repository: https://github.com/GSterlingPress/mailtype-api

Core REST operations:
GET /v1/domain/{domain}
GET /v1/email/{email}

MCP tool:
inspect_mail_domain(input)

Returns objective domain-level evidence including domain existence, ability to receive mail, MX records/provider, disposable-domain evidence, SPF, DMARC, MTA-STS, confidence, evidence, and checked_at.

MAILTYPE does not perform mailbox verification, SMTP probing, or send email. UNKNOWN is returned when evidence is insufficient.
